meta.strict_mode_note: Default mode reports honestly and exits 0; --strict exits 1 if any gate fails.

gates.name: Batch 002+ Arabizi/mixed scale
gates.target: >=40 Arabizi/mixed rows total before final Arabizi F1 claims
gates.why: Small-N Batch 001 is regression evidence, not final model evidence.

gates.name: Native Lebanese/dialect review
gates.target: >=90% of Arabizi/mixed rows reviewed by NATIVE-/LEB-/DIALECT- reviewer
gates.why: Codex/Claude review is useful, but native dialect review is the strongest defense.

gates.name: Arabizi cross-language duplicate evidence
gates.target: >=10 duplicate pairs where one side is Arabizi/mixed and languages differ
gates.why: CedarFix's originality depends on multilingual incident fusion, not standalone text classification.

gates.name: Arabizi hard-negative coverage
gates.why: Hard negatives prove the dedup model avoids false merges in realistic same-area cases.

gates.name: Arabizi unrelated-negative coverage
gates.target: >=5 UNRELATED pairs involving Arabizi/mixed by Batch 002+
gates.why: Cross-cluster unrelated pairs stop semantic similarity from becoming false duplicates.

gates.name: Regression and demo artifacts
gates.target: benchmark, stress lab, and live certificate artifacts exist
gates.why: The Arabizi claim needs reproducible evidence and a demo artifact, not only source code.
